name: ahead-pi
description: AHEAD workflow enforcement and context for Pi

scripts.build: npm run build:instructions && npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck
scripts.format: cd ../.. && integrations/pi/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt -c ./.oxfmtrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json scripts integrations/pi/scripts integrations/pi/src integrations/pi/test integrations/pi/package.json integrations/pi/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:source && npm run lint:types
scripts.lint:source: cd ../.. && integrations/pi/node_modules/.bin/oxlint -c ./.oxlintrc.json --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=off scripts integrations/pi/scripts integrations/pi/src integrations/pi/test
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run format:check && npm run lint && node --test ./test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run pack:verify
